_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3: deferred tax assets, liabilities and provisions per IAS 12 / RJ 272. Five new schemas: TemporaryDifference (per-account balance-sheet timing difference), TaxLossCarryForward (compensable losses per jurisdiction + regime per Wet Vpb art. 20/20a), TaxRateReconciliation (ETR disclosure table per), DeferredTaxMovement (roll-forward per category/jurisdiction per), TaxProvision (aggregated balance-sheet DTA/DTL position per). Additive extensions on T1 Account (taxBasisDifferenceCategory hint) and FiscalPeriod (enactedTaxRates for rate-change handling per). TaxRateReconciliation is produced by x-openregister-calculations (ADR-031, design D2); no PHP report service. TaxCalculationService orchestrates detection, loss-compensation and rate-change re-measurement and is the thin engine-side fallback per design D1. No seed data required. Records accumulate from GL on balansdatum.

TemporaryDifference.title: Temporary Difference
TemporaryDifference.description: Per-account, per-period detection of a timing difference between commercial carrying amount and tax basis at balansdatum. Taxable differences create DTL; deductible differences create DTA. Permanent differences (deelnemingsvrijstelling etc.) must NOT be stored here: they appear in TaxRateReconciliation.reconciliationItems with type=permanent.

periodId.description: Fiscal period identifier for balansdatum (FK to FiscalPeriod).
periodId.title: Period ID

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the tax jurisdiction. NL, DE, BE, etc.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

accountNumber.description: RGS general-ledger account code (FK to Account.accountNumber).
accountNumber.title: Account Number

category.description: Deferred-tax category. Drives roll-forward grouping in DeferredTaxMovement. May be pre-tagged via Account.taxBasisDifferenceCategory.
category.title: Category

commercialCarryingAmount.description: Commercial carrying amount in euro cents at balansdatum (IAS 12 §5). Integer cents per ADR-022 money rule.
commercialCarryingAmount.title: Commercial Carrying Amount

taxCarryingAmount.description: Tax basis (fiscale boekwaarde) in euro cents at balansdatum (IAS 12 §5). Integer cents.
taxCarryingAmount.title: Tax Carrying Amount

temporaryDifference.description: Computed timing difference in euro cents: commercialCarryingAmount − taxCarryingAmount. Negative for deductible differences. Integer cents.
temporaryDifference.title: Temporary Difference

type.description: Taxable differences create DTL; deductible differences create DTA.
type.title: Type

reversalPattern.description: Expected reversal horizon. Used to determine whether a rate change applies.
reversalPattern.title: Reversal Pattern

expectedReversalYear.description: Year in which the difference is expected to reverse. Required when reversalPattern is long-term.
expectedReversalYear.title: Expected Reversal Year

taxRate.description: Applied tax rate in basis points (1/10000). 2580 = 25.80%. Sourced from FiscalPeriod.enactedTaxRates[jurisdiction] for the expectedReversalYear.
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

deferredTaxBalance.description: Computed deferred-tax position in euro cents: temporaryDifference × taxRate / 10000. Positive for DTL; negative for DTA. Integer cents.
deferredTaxBalance.title: Deferred Tax Balance

notes.description: Free-text auditor notes on the specific difference (optional).
notes.title: Notes

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this record belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

TaxLossCarryForward.title: Tax-loss Carry-forward
TaxLossCarryForward.description: Compensable tax loss per jurisdiction per origination year, tracked under the applicable Wet Vpb compensation regime (pre-2019 6-year, 2019–2021 transitional, 2022+ unlimited with 50%-above-EUR-1M cap per). remainingAmount is computed as originalAmount − utilisedAmount.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the tax jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

originatingYear.description: Fiscal year in which the loss originated (determines which regime applies per).
originatingYear.title: Originating Year

originalAmount.description: Original loss amount in euro cents (positive integer). Integer cents per ADR-022.
originalAmount.title: Original Amount

utilisedAmount.description: Cumulative amount utilised for offset in euro cents (positive integer). Integer cents.
utilisedAmount.title: Utilised Amount

remainingAmount.description: Computed remaining compensable loss in euro cents: originalAmount − utilisedAmount. Integer cents.
remainingAmount.title: Remaining Amount

expirationYear.description: Year the loss expires under the applicable regime. Null for 2022+ unlimited regime.
expirationYear.title: Expiration Year

applicableRegime.description: Wet Vpb loss-compensation regime. Determines expiry and the 50%-cap logic for 2022+.
applicableRegime.title: Applicable Regime

dtaRecognised.description: Deferred-tax asset recognised on this loss in euro cents. May be less than remainingAmount × taxRate if recoverability assessment limits recognition. Integer cents.
dtaRecognised.title: Dta Recognised

dtaRecoverabilityRationale.description: Mandatory documented rationale for the recognised DTA percentage. Must cite the projection basis.
dtaRecoverabilityRationale.example: Supported by 5-year budget projection; EUR 3M cumulative taxable profit expected.
dtaRecoverabilityRationale.title: Dta Recoverability Rationale

recoverabilityHorizon.description: Number of years over which recoverability is projected.
recoverabilityHorizon.title: Recoverability Horizon

linkedProjections.description: FK references to forecast records in bookkeeping-budget-multi-year supporting the recoverability assessment.
linkedProjections.title: Linked Projections

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this record belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

TaxRateReconciliation.title: Tax Rate Reconciliation
TaxRateReconciliation.description: Complete ETR reconciliation per period per jurisdiction (IAS 12 §81(c) / RJ 272). Produced as x-openregister-calculations output (ADR-031, design D2). Starts at statutory rate × profitBeforeTax and adjusts for permanent differences, temporary differences, rate changes and prior-year items to arrive at effectiveTaxExpense and effectiveTaxRate.

periodId.description: Fiscal period for the ETR reconciliation (FK to FiscalPeriod).
periodId.title: Period ID

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. One record per period per jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

profitBeforeTax.description: Profit before income tax in euro cents per P&L. Integer cents.
profitBeforeTax.title: Profit Before Tax

statutoryRate.description: Blended statutory tax rate in basis points (1/10000). 2580 = 25.80%. For NL 2026: 1900 on first EUR 200k, 2580 above.
statutoryRate.title: Statutory Rate

statutoryTaxExpense.description: Computed statutory tax expense in euro cents: profitBeforeTax × statutoryRate / 10000. Integer cents.
statutoryTaxExpense.title: Statutory Tax Expense

reconciliationItems.description: Ordered list of permanent-difference, temporary-difference, rate-change and prior-year items that bridge statutory to effective tax expense.

description.description: Human-readable label for the reconciliation line (e.g. 'Dividend exemption', 'Non-deductible gifts').
description.title: Description

type.description: Classification of the reconciliation item per IAS 12 §81(c).
type.title: Type

amount.description: Pre-tax income effect in euro cents (positive = income, negative = expense).
amount.title: Amount

taxEffect.description: Tax effect of this item in euro cents (positive = increases tax expense, negative = reduces it).
taxEffect.title: Tax Effect

reconciliationItems.title: Reconciliation Items

effectiveTaxExpense.description: Computed effective tax expense in euro cents: statutoryTaxExpense + sum(reconciliationItems[].taxEffect). Integer cents.
effectiveTaxExpense.title: Effective Tax Expense

effectiveTaxRate.description: Computed effective tax rate in basis points: effectiveTaxExpense / profitBeforeTax × 10000. Integer basis points.
effectiveTaxRate.title: Effective Tax Rate

disclosureNarrative.description: Free-form or structured narrative for jaarrekening note disclosure per RJ 272 / IAS 12 §81.
disclosureNarrative.title: Disclosure Narrative

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this record belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

DeferredTaxMovement.title: Deferred Tax Movement
DeferredTaxMovement.description: Roll-forward of the deferred-tax balance per fiscal period per jurisdiction per category. Captures opening balance, originations, reversals, rate-change effects, business-combination gains and FX adjustments; closingBalance and recognisedInPL are computed. One record per (periodId, jurisdiction, category, administrationId).

periodId.description: Fiscal period for this roll-forward row (FK to FiscalPeriod).
periodId.title: Period ID

openingBalance.description: Deferred-tax balance at start of period in euro cents. Positive for DTL, negative for DTA. Integer cents.
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

originatedInPeriod.description: New deferred-tax positions created during the period in euro cents. Integer cents.
originatedInPeriod.title: Originated In Period

reversedInPeriod.description: Deferred-tax positions that reversed during the period in euro cents (typically negative). Integer cents.
reversedInPeriod.title: Reversed In Period

rateChangeAdjustment.description: Adjustment resulting from an enacted tax-rate change in euro cents. Integer cents.
rateChangeAdjustment.title: Rate Change Adjustment

acquiredViaBusinessCombination.description: Deferred-tax positions acquired via a business combination (IFRS 3) in euro cents. Integer cents.
acquiredViaBusinessCombination.title: Acquired Via Business Combination

translationAdjustment.description: FX translation effect on deferred-tax balances of foreign operations in euro cents (OCI component). Integer cents.
translationAdjustment.title: Translation Adjustment

recognisedInPL.description: Computed P&L income-statement effect: originatedInPeriod + reversedInPeriod + rateChangeAdjustment + acquiredViaBusinessCombination. Integer cents.
recognisedInPL.title: Recognised In Pl

recognisedInOCI.description: Deferred-tax recognised directly in OCI (pension / hedging instruments). Integer cents.
recognisedInOCI.title: Recognised In Oci

closingBalance.description: Computed closing deferred-tax balance: openingBalance + originatedInPeriod + reversedInPeriod + rateChangeAdjustment + acquiredViaBusinessCombination + translationAdjustment + recognisedInOCI. Integer cents.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

linkedJournalEntries.description: FK references to GL journal entries posting the deferred-tax expense.
linkedJournalEntries.title: Linked Journal Entries

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this record belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

closingBalance.expression: openingBalance + originatedInPeriod + reversedInPeriod + rateChangeAdjustment + acquiredViaBusinessCombination + translationAdjustment + recognisedInOCI

TaxProvision.title: Tax Provision
TaxProvision.description: Aggregated balance-sheet deferred-tax position per fiscal period per jurisdiction (IAS 12 §71–78). Holds current-tax payable/prepaid, total DTA and DTL, the computed net position, the saldering presentation choice (gross/net) and the FK to the Vpb return for reconciliation.

periodId.description: Fiscal period for this provision record (FK to FiscalPeriod).
periodId.title: Period ID

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. One record per period per jurisdiction.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

currentTaxPayable.description: Current Vpb payable for the period in euro cents (positive). Integer cents.
currentTaxPayable.title: Current Tax Payable

currentTaxPrepaid.description: Vpb prepaid / voorheffing in euro cents (positive reduces net payable). Integer cents.
currentTaxPrepaid.title: Current Tax Prepaid

dtaTotal.description: Total deferred-tax asset across all categories for this period/jurisdiction in euro cents (positive). Sourced from DeferredTaxMovement closingBalance (negative = DTA). Integer cents.
dtaTotal.title: Dta Total

dtlTotal.description: Total deferred-tax liability across all categories for this period/jurisdiction in euro cents (positive). Sourced from DeferredTaxMovement closingBalance (positive = DTL). Integer cents.
dtlTotal.title: Dtl Total

netDtaDtlPosition.description: Computed net DTA/DTL position in euro cents: dtlTotal − dtaTotal. Positive when net liability. Integer cents.
netDtaDtlPosition.title: Net Dta Dtl Position

presentationOnBalanceSheet.description: Saldering choice per IAS 12 §71–78. Gross = separate DTA and DTL lines; net = combined position. Determined by legal right to offset within the same jurisdiction.
presentationOnBalanceSheet.title: Presentation On Balance Sheet

linkedVpbReturn.description: FK to the Vpb-aangifte record in bookkeeping-vpb-mkb for current-tax reconciliation.
linkedVpbReturn.title: Linked VpB Return

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this record belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

Account.description: ADR-037 additive extension: adds optional taxBasisDifferenceCategory enum hint on Account. When set, TaxCalculationService uses this hint to automatically classify the account's commercial/tax difference; without it the operator specifies the category directly in TemporaryDifference.

taxBasisDifferenceCategory.description: Optional hint for the deferred-tax GL detection logic. Maps this account to a TemporaryDifference.category so detection is automatic. Leave null for accounts with no expected timing difference.
taxBasisDifferenceCategory.title: Tax Basis Difference Category

FiscalPeriod.description: ADR-037 additive extension: adds enactedTaxRates object on FiscalPeriod for rate-change adjustment. Keyed by jurisdiction (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); each entry carries rate in basis points and the effective date of the enacted law.

enactedTaxRates.description: Enacted tax rates per jurisdiction effective on or after balansdatum. Key = ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Rate in basis points (1/10000). Used by TaxCalculationService to re-measure positions reverting on/after effectiveDate.

effectiveDate.description: Date from which the enacted rate applies.

enactedTaxRates.title: Enacted Tax Rates
